program.name: Boxer's Body
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Boxing bouts followed by bodyweight strength, for the shoulders, legs and back a boxer stands on.
program.about: Boxing bouts, then bodyweight strength for a boxer's body. Push-ups and rows build the shoulders and back, and single-leg work builds the legs. The upper day ends with a shoulder flow, the lower day with a hip flow, and the third day is a full-body circuit with abs. Levels II and III bring longer combinations in the bouts, more reps in the strength and longer holds in the flows. No equipment.
program.split: Upper & shoulders flow / lower & hips flow / full-body circuit & abs
